author: Nicole A. Pelot

steps.title: Bake and Cool Slides
steps.instruction: Bake slides containing paraffin-embedded vagus nerve sections overnight at 50°C, then cool overnight.

steps.title: Deparaffinize and Hydrate Slides
steps.instruction: Deparaffinize and hydrate the slides to distilled water using the following sequence:

substeps.instruction: Xylene (2x 6 min)
100% ethanol (5 min)
95% ethanol (4 min)
70% ethanol (3 min)
Deionized water (2x 1 min)

steps.title: Perform Heat-Induced Epitope Retrieval (HIER)
steps.instruction: Perform HIER using a buffer with pH 6.0 (Thermo, TA-135-HBL) at the following temperatures:

substeps.instruction: 120°C for 30 s
90°C for 10 s

steps.title: Permeabilize and Block
steps.instruction: Prepare the samples for staining through permeabilization and blocking:

substeps.instruction: Incubate in 0.1% (v/v) Triton-X in PBS for 20 min
Incubate in 7.5% (w/v) bovine serum albumin (BSA) in PBS for 1 hour
Rinse with 1% (w/v) BSA in PBS

steps.title: Apply Primary Antibody
steps.instruction: Apply rabbit anti-fibronectin (Sigma, F3648) diluted 1:50 in 1% (w/v) BSA in PBS and incubate overnight at 4°C.

steps.title: Rinse After Primary Antibody
steps.instruction: Rinse the slides with PBS (3x 5 min).

steps.title: Apply Secondary Antibody
steps.instruction: Apply goat polyclonal secondary antibody to rabbit IgG (H+L, FITC) (Abcam, ab97050) diluted 1:100 in 1% (v/v) BSA in PBS and incubate for 1 hour at room temperature.

steps.title: Rinse After Secondary Antibody
steps.instruction: Rinse the slides in PBS (3x 5 min).

steps.title: Image Samples
steps.instruction: Image the samples at 20x using a Plan Apochromat Lambda (NA: 0.75), a GFP/FITC/cy2 filter set, a SOLA SE II 365 light engine, and a Photometrics Prime 95B-25MM camera.

substeps.instruction: Filter set parameters: excitation 466/40 nm (446-486 nm), emission 525/50 nm (500-550 nm), dichroic mirror 495 nm
Select the best of four slices per sample based on quality (no tearing or fraying)

steps.title: Image Preprocessing and Segmentation
steps.instruction: Process the captured images to identify the perineurium:

substeps.instruction: Apply preprocessing steps such as smoothing and sharpening
Select fluorescent intensity values to identify the perineurium
Apply postprocessing steps: set minimum size criterion to eliminate small off-target regions, smoothing, cleaning, closing, and filling holes
Perform manual adjustments, including deletion of off-target regions and filling of missed target areas
Convert the binary segmented image into 'Graticule Masks' (binary images saved as TIFs)

steps.title: Analyze Morphology via Matlab
steps.instruction: Use Matlab to quantify the perineurium dimensions:

substeps.instruction: Import TIFs and generate x and y coordinates of pixels for each closed boundary using the bwboundaries function
Pair the interior and exterior perineurium traces for a given fascicle
Scale pixel coordinates to microns using the segmented scale bar
Calculate the effective diameter of inner and outer perineurium traces using polyarea (effective diameter is the diameter of a circle with the same cross-sectional area as the raw trace)
Calculate perineurium thickness as half of the difference between the effective diameters of the inner and outer perineurium traces
